## Dire Racoon (CR 2)

**XP** 600  
 N Small animal  
 **Init** +3; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +11  

**Defense**

 **AC** 19, touch 14, flat-footed 16 (+3 Dex, +5 natural, +1 size)  
 **hp** 24 (2d8+8)  
 **Fort** +7, **Ref** +6, **Will** +3  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft., climb 30 ft.  
 **Melee** bite +5 (1d4+3 plus disease)  
 **Special Attacks** disease  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 13, **Dex** 17, **Con** 18, **Int** 2, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 9  
 **Base Atk** +1; **CMB** +3; **CMD** 14 (18 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** Weapon Finesse  
*House rules: Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
 **Skills** Climb +9, Perception +11, Stealth +11, Swim +5; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Perception, +4 Swim  

**Special Abilities**

 **Disease (Ex)** **Filth fever**: Bite—injury; *save* Fort DC 15; onset 1d3 days; *frequency* 1 day; *effect* 1d3 Dex damage and 1d3 Con damage; *cure* 2 consecutive saves.  

**Ecology**

**Environment** temperate forests and urban  
 **Organization** solitary, pair, or family (1 adult plus 1–4 young)  
 **Treasure** incidental
